info.description: App handoff, 21 October 2026. Read docs/APP_TEAM_API.md. No /api prefix. Set baseUrl, credentials and real IDs. Choose one registration role. Run individual requests; full collection runner will perform conflicting state-changing alternatives. Authentication stores collection token. Use different learner/provider tokens for full flows. Production SMS and email codes must be entered manually. Does not include admin or legacy Express routes. Saved responses named Mock are fictional examples checked against controller response shapes, not live server captures. In Postman expand a request and select its saved example to preview the status, headers and JSON body without sending it. Mock tokens and IDs are illustrative; use real credentials/IDs for live requests. Normal signup: No Auth at OTP request/verify, then save the verification token. Google signup: send authMethod=google and the sign-in bearer to both OTP APIs; verification returns a fresh token for the same Google-linked user. Save that token for registration and later APIs. Deploy migration 000031 first.
